questions.scenario: Ten rabbits were released on a small island with no predators. Their numbers were counted every 2 years.
questions.scenarioAf: Tien hase is op ’n klein eiland sonder roofdiere vrygelaat. Hul getalle is elke 2 jaar getel.

questions.q: Name the shape of the growth curve that these results produce.
questions.qAf: Noem die vorm van die groeikurwe wat hierdie resultate lewer.
points: sigmoid (S-shaped)
pointsAf: sigmoïed (S-vormig)

questions.q: Name the phase of growth between 4 and 6 years.
questions.qAf: Noem die groeifase tussen 4 en 6 jaar.
points: exponential (log) phase
pointsAf: eksponensiële (log-) fase

questions.q: Write down the carrying capacity of the island for rabbits.
questions.qAf: Skryf die drakrag van die eiland vir hase neer.
points: 300 rabbits
pointsAf: 300 hase

questions.q: Explain why the population stopped increasing after about 10 years.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die bevolking ná ongeveer 10 jaar opgehou het om toe te neem.
points: There was competition for limited food and space
disease spread more easily in the crowded population
so the death rate became equal to the birth rate
pointsAf: Daar was kompetisie vir beperkte voedsel en ruimte
siekte het makliker in die oorvol bevolking versprei
dus het die sterftesyfer gelyk geword aan die geboortesyfer

questions.q: Name the phase of growth when the population stays at the carrying capacity.
questions.qAf: Noem die groeifase wanneer die bevolking by die drakrag bly.
points: stationary (equilibrium) phase
pointsAf: stasionêre (ewewigs-) fase

questions.q: Draw a line graph of the results.
questions.qAf: Teken ’n lyngrafiek van die resultate.
points: Correct type of graph (line graph)
Caption that names both variables
x-axis: time (years) with a suitable scale
y-axis: number of rabbits with a suitable scale
All points plotted correctly
pointsAf: Korrekte soort grafiek (lyngrafiek)
Opskrif wat albei veranderlikes noem
x-as: tyd (jare) met ’n geskikte skaal
y-as: aantal hase met ’n geskikte skaal
Al die punte korrek gestip

questions.q: Is the rabbit population on the island open or closed? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Is die hasebevolking op die eiland oop of geslote? Gee ’n rede.
points: Closed, because rabbits cannot move onto or off the island (no migration)
pointsAf: Geslote, omdat hase nie na of van die eiland kan beweeg nie (geen migrasie nie)

questions.q: Give ONE factor of environmental resistance that limits the rabbit population.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN faktor van omgewingsweerstand wat die hasebevolking beperk.
points: shortage of food, water or space, or disease
pointsAf: tekort aan voedsel, water of ruimte, of siekte

questions.q: Write a word equation for anaerobic respiration in human muscle cells.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n woordvergelyking vir anaërobiese respirasie in menslike spierselle.
points: glucose →
lactic acid + energy (ATP)
pointsAf: glukose →
melksuur + energie (ATP)

questions.q: Name the organelle where most ATP is made, and give TWO uses of ATP in the body.
questions.qAf: Noem die organel waar die meeste ATP gemaak word, en gee TWEE gebruike van ATP in die liggaam.
points: mitochondrion
muscle contraction
active transport, growth, or building large molecules
pointsAf: mitochondrion
spiersametrekking
aktiewe transport, groei, of die bou van groot molekules

questions.q: Describe glycolysis.
questions.qAf: Beskryf glikolise.
points: Each glucose molecule is broken down into two molecules of pyruvate (pyruvic acid)
in the cytoplasm
producing a small amount of ATP (2 molecules)
pointsAf: Elke glukosemolekuul word in twee molekules pirodruiwesuur (piruvaat) afgebreek
in die sitoplasma
wat ’n klein hoeveelheid ATP (2 molekules) lewer

questions.q: Tabulate TWO differences between alcoholic fermentation and lactic acid fermentation.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer TWEE verskille tussen alkoholiese gisting en melksuurgisting.
points: Alcoholic: takes place in yeast (and plants) / Lactic acid: takes place in muscle cells (and some bacteria)
Alcoholic: produces ethanol and carbon dioxide / Lactic acid: produces lactic acid only
pointsAf: Alkoholies: vind in gis (en plante) plaas / Melksuur: vind in spierselle (en sommige bakterieë) plaas
Alkoholies: produseer etanol en koolstofdioksied / Melksuur: produseer slegs melksuur

questions.q: Explain what is meant by oxygen debt.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik wat met suurstofskuld bedoel word.
points: After strenuous exercise, a person keeps breathing fast and deeply
to take in extra oxygen
which is used to break down the lactic acid that built up in the muscles
pointsAf: Ná strawwe oefening hou ’n persoon aan om vinnig en diep asem te haal
om ekstra suurstof in te neem
wat gebruik word om die melksuur af te breek wat in die spiere opgehoop het

questions.q: Explain why aerobic respiration releases much more energy than anaerobic respiration.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom aërobiese respirasie baie meer energie vrystel as anaërobiese respirasie.
points: In aerobic respiration glucose is broken down completely to carbon dioxide and water
producing about 36 ATP per glucose instead of 2
in anaerobic respiration much energy stays locked in lactic acid or ethanol
pointsAf: In aërobiese respirasie word glukose volledig na koolstofdioksied en water afgebreek
wat ongeveer 36 ATP per glukose lewer in plaas van 2
in anaërobiese respirasie bly baie energie in melksuur of etanol opgesluit

questions.q: Explain why a flask of germinating seeds becomes warmer.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n fles met ontkiemende sade warmer word.
points: The seeds carry out cellular respiration
which releases energy, some of it as heat
pointsAf: Die sade voer sellulêre respirasie uit
wat energie vrystel, waarvan ’n deel as hitte

questions.q: Name, in order, FOUR structures through which air passes from the nose to the alveoli.
questions.qAf: Noem, in volgorde, VIER strukture waardeur lug van die neus na die alveoli beweeg.
points: nasal cavity
pharynx or larynx
trachea
bronchi and bronchioles
pointsAf: neusholte
farinks of larinks
tragea
brongi en brongiole

questions.q: Describe the process of exhalation.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die proses van uitaseming.
points: The external intercostal muscles relax and the ribs move down and in
the diaphragm relaxes and becomes dome-shaped
the volume of the thoracic cavity decreases, so the pressure inside increases
air is forced out of the lungs
pointsAf: Die buitenste tussenribspiere ontspan en die ribbes beweeg af en in
die diafragma ontspan en word koepelvormig
die volume van die borsholte neem af, dus neem die druk binne toe
lug word uit die longe gedruk

questions.q: Give FOUR ways in which the alveoli are adapted for gaseous exchange.
questions.qAf: Gee VIER maniere waarop die alveoli by gaswisseling aangepas is.
points: There are millions of alveoli, giving a large surface area
the walls are only one cell thick
the inner surface is moist
each alveolus is surrounded by a dense network of capillaries
pointsAf: Daar is miljoene alveoli, wat ’n groot oppervlakte gee
die wande is slegs een sel dik
die binneoppervlak is klam
elke alveolus is deur ’n digte netwerk kapillêre omring

questions.q: Describe how oxygen is transported in the blood.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe suurstof in die bloed vervoer word.
points: Oxygen combines with haemoglobin in the red blood cells
to form oxyhaemoglobin
pointsAf: Suurstof verbind met hemoglobien in die rooibloedselle
om oksihemoglobien te vorm

questions.q: Describe how carbon dioxide is transported in the blood.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe koolstofdioksied in die bloed vervoer word.
points: Mostly as hydrogen carbonate (bicarbonate) ions in the plasma
some is carried by haemoglobin or dissolved in the plasma
pointsAf: Meestal as waterstofkarbonaat- (bikarbonaat-) ione in die plasma
’n deel word deur hemoglobien vervoer of is in die plasma opgelos

questions.q: Explain why a single-celled organism such as Amoeba does not need special gas-exchange organs.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n eensellige organisme soos Amoeba nie spesiale gaswisselingsorgane nodig het nie.
points: It has a large surface area to volume ratio
so diffusion across its cell membrane supplies enough oxygen
pointsAf: Dit het ’n groot oppervlakte-tot-volume-verhouding
dus verskaf diffusie oor sy selmembraan genoeg suurstof

questions.q: Name the disease in which the walls of the alveoli break down.
questions.qAf: Noem die siekte waarin die wande van die alveoli afbreek.
points: emphysema
pointsAf: emfiseem

questions.q: Name the gas-exchange system of an insect.
questions.qAf: Noem die gaswisselingstelsel van ’n insek.
points: the tracheal system (tracheae)
pointsAf: die trageestelsel (trageë)

questions.q: Define population density.
questions.qAf: Definieer bevolkingsdigtheid.
points: The number of individuals of a species
per unit area (or volume)
pointsAf: Die aantal individue van ’n spesie
per eenheidsoppervlakte (of -volume)

questions.q: Five quadrats of 1 m² were placed in a field of 200 m². The numbers of daisies counted were 4, 6, 3, 5 and 2. Estimate the number of daisies in the field.
questions.qAf: Vyf kwadrate van 1 m² is in ’n veld van 200 m² geplaas. Die aantal madeliefies wat getel is, was 4, 6, 3, 5 en 2. Skat die aantal madeliefies in die veld.
points: total = 20 in 5 m²
average = 4 per m²
4 × 200 = 800 daisies
pointsAf: totaal = 20 in 5 m²
gemiddeld = 4 per m²
4 × 200 = 800 madeliefies

questions.q: Give TWO precautions to take when using quadrats.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voorsorgmaatreëls wanneer kwadrate gebruik word.
points: Place the quadrats randomly
use enough quadrats of the same size
pointsAf: Plaas die kwadrate lukraak
gebruik genoeg kwadrate van dieselfde grootte

questions.q: Name TWO factors that decrease the size of a population.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE faktore wat die grootte van ’n bevolking verminder.
points: deaths (mortality)
emigration
pointsAf: sterftes (mortaliteit)
emigrasie

questions.q: Distinguish between intraspecific and interspecific competition, and give an example of each.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen intraspesifieke en interspesifieke kompetisie, en gee ’n voorbeeld van elk.
points: Intraspecific: competition between individuals of the same species
e.g. two lions competing for a mate
Interspecific: competition between individuals of different species
e.g. lions and hyenas competing for prey
pointsAf: Intraspesifiek: kompetisie tussen individue van dieselfde spesie
bv. twee leeus wat om ’n maat meeding
Interspesifiek: kompetisie tussen individue van verskillende spesies
bv. leeus en hiënas wat om prooi meeding

questions.q: Describe commensalism and parasitism, and give an example of each.
questions.qAf: Beskryf kommensalisme en parasitisme, en gee ’n voorbeeld van elk.
points: Commensalism: one organism benefits and the other is not affected
e.g. barnacles on a whale, or an epiphyte on a tree
Parasitism: one organism benefits and the other (the host) is harmed
e.g. a tick on a dog, or a tapeworm in a human
pointsAf: Kommensalisme: een organisme trek voordeel en die ander word nie geraak nie
bv. eendemossels op ’n walvis, of ’n epifiet op ’n boom
Parasitisme: een organisme trek voordeel en die ander (die gasheer) word benadeel
bv. ’n bosluis op ’n hond, of ’n lintwurm in ’n mens

questions.q: Give TWO advantages for animals of living in social groups.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele vir diere om in sosiale groepe te leef.
points: better protection against predators
hunting together, or sharing the care of the young
pointsAf: beter beskerming teen roofdiere
saam jag, of die versorging van die kleintjies deel

questions.q: Distinguish between primary and secondary succession.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen primêre en sekondêre suksessie.
points: Primary succession starts on bare rock where there is no soil
with pioneer species such as lichens
secondary succession takes place where soil is already present, e.g. after a fire
pointsAf: Primêre suksessie begin op kaal rots waar daar geen grond is nie
met pionierspesies soos ligene
sekondêre suksessie vind plaas waar grond reeds teenwoordig is, bv. ná ’n brand

questions.q: Explain how deforestation contributes to climate change.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ontbossing tot klimaatsverandering bydra.
points: Fewer trees are left to absorb carbon dioxide for photosynthesis
burning or decay of the cut trees releases carbon dioxide
more greenhouse gas traps more heat, so the Earth warms up
pointsAf: Minder bome bly oor om koolstofdioksied vir fotosintese te absorbeer
die verbranding of ontbinding van die afgekapte bome stel koolstofdioksied vry
meer kweekhuisgas vang meer hitte, dus word die Aarde warmer

questions.q: Give TWO other consequences of deforestation.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE ander gevolge van ontbossing.
points: soil erosion
loss of habitats and biodiversity
pointsAf: gronderosie
verlies aan habitatte en biodiversiteit

questions.q: State the function of the ozone layer.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van die osoonlaag.
points: It absorbs harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation from the Sun
pointsAf: Dit absorbeer skadelike ultraviolet (UV) straling van die Son

questions.q: Give ONE health effect of a thinner ozone layer.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN gesondheidseffek van ’n dunner osoonlaag.
points: skin cancer or cataracts
pointsAf: velkanker of katarakte

questions.q: What is an ecological footprint?
questions.qAf: Wat is ’n ekologiese voetspoor?
points: The area of land and water needed to supply the resources a person uses and to absorb their waste
pointsAf: Die oppervlakte land en water wat nodig is om die hulpbronne wat ’n persoon gebruik te verskaf en sy afval te absorbeer

questions.q: Give ONE way in which a person can reduce their ecological footprint.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN manier waarop ’n persoon sy ekologiese voetspoor kan verklein.
points: use less electricity and water, recycle, or use public transport
pointsAf: gebruik minder elektrisiteit en water, herwin, of gebruik openbare vervoer

questions.q: Explain how acid rain forms.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe suurreën vorm.
points: Burning coal and fuels releases sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides
these gases dissolve in water in the clouds
forming sulfuric and nitric acids that fall as acid rain
pointsAf: Die verbranding van steenkool en brandstof stel swaweldioksied en stikstofoksiede vry
hierdie gasse los in water in die wolke op
en vorm swawel- en salpetersuur wat as suurreën val

questions.q: Give TWO effects of acid rain.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE gevolge van suurreën.
points: It damages plants and forests
it lowers the pH of lakes and kills aquatic life, or it corrodes buildings
pointsAf: Dit beskadig plante en woude
dit verlaag die pH van mere en maak waterlewe dood, of dit korrodeer geboue

questions.q: Give TWO ways to improve food security in South Africa.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere om voedselsekuriteit in Suid-Afrika te verbeter.
points: grow drought-resistant crops, or use efficient irrigation
reduce food waste, or support small-scale farming
pointsAf: verbou droogtebestande gewasse, of gebruik doeltreffende besproeiing
verminder voedselvermorsing, of ondersteun kleinskaalse boerdery

questions.q: Name TWO renewable sources of energy.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE hernubare energiebronne.
points: solar energy
wind or hydro-electric energy
pointsAf: sonenergie
wind- of hidro-elektriese energie

questions.q:
Describe how eutrophication happens and how it can be prevented, and explain why alien invasive plants are a problem in South Africa and how they can be controlled.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf hoe eutrofikasie gebeur en hoe dit voorkom kan word, en verduidelik waarom uitheemse indringerplante ’n probleem in Suid-Afrika is en hoe hulle beheer kan word.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points: Fertilisers and untreated sewage wash into rivers and dams
They add nitrates and phosphates to the water
Algae grow very quickly (an algal bloom)
The algae block sunlight, so water plants below them die
Bacteria decompose the dead algae and plants and use up the oxygen
Fish and other animals die from a lack of oxygen
Eutrophication can be prevented by treating sewage properly
and by using less fertiliser or leaving strips of natural vegetation along rivers
Alien invasive plants were brought in from other countries
They have no natural enemies here, so they spread quickly
They outcompete indigenous plants, which reduces biodiversity
Many use large amounts of water, which reduces the water in rivers and dams
Some make fires burn hotter
They can be removed mechanically, by cutting or pulling them out
or controlled chemically with herbicides
or by biological control, using insects or diseases from their home countries
Programmes such as Working for Water remove invasive plants
pointsAf: Kunsmis en onbehandelde riool spoel in riviere en damme in
Dit voeg nitrate en fosfate by die water
Alge groei baie vinnig (’n algbloei)
Die alge keer sonlig, dus sterf waterplante onder hulle
Bakterieë ontbind die dooie alge en plante en gebruik die suurstof op
Visse en ander diere sterf weens ’n tekort aan suurstof
Eutrofikasie kan voorkom word deur riool behoorlik te behandel
en deur minder kunsmis te gebruik of stroke natuurlike plantegroei langs riviere te los
Uitheemse indringerplante is uit ander lande ingebring
Hulle het geen natuurlike vyande hier nie, dus versprei hulle vinnig
Hulle verdring inheemse plante, wat biodiversiteit verminder
Baie gebruik groot hoeveelhede water, wat die water in riviere en damme verminder
Sommige laat vure warmer brand
Hulle kan meganies verwyder word, deur hulle af te kap of uit te trek
of chemies met onkruiddoders beheer word
of deur biologiese beheer, met insekte of siektes uit hul tuislande
Programme soos Werk vir Water verwyder indringerplante
